title: Counts and release state disagree across README, release notes, EVIDENCE.json and security pages
preconditions: A reader relying on those documents
description: The release notes call the tree a development BETA that is not the sealed release, while the tagged commit's subject is 'trust: seal 0.9.3.5'. README says 1,503 theorems (EVIDENCE 1,604), 222 proof crates (232), 67 driver capsules (catalogue 64 driver slugs), and release notes say 24 fuzz targets in CI (fuzz/targets.json lists 49). EVIDENCE.json bv_decide_calls is 23 against 10 when regenerated, and the script header's 'CI regenerates and diffs' is not wired. CEREMONY.md says Groth16 and 57 capsules (168 STARK trailers). Citations: docs/security cites a path that no longer exists and two line ranges past end of file.
scenario: A reader relying on those documents

steps: git log/tag, grep counts, collect-evidence.sh run and diffed against EVIDENCE.json (one field differs), citation spot checks; independent rerun.
NOT done: Website text not checked; the full citation checker was not rerun.

remediation: Generate the figures from EVIDENCE.json, wire the regeneration diff into CI, fix the citations.
